CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), organization/pattern (large set of coordinates) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for p0/current/n2.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation statement linking attention or processing condition to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color-labelled coordinate sets) are provided (e.g., red and blue positions).

D.rationale: The report separates content identity (red coordinate set) from a status/origin field for the same referent (origin = copied_prior_record), thereby distinguishing content from its representation/status.

O.rationale: The coordinate list shows how the content is presented as an organized spatial pattern (bound positions) for p0/current/n2.
